speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Impetigo (Bullous impetigo). The clinical presentation of a generalized maculopapular rash with pustules featuring an erythematous base in a newborn is highly characteristic of this superficial bacterial infection, typically caused by *Staphylococcus aureus* or *Streptococcus pyogenes*. The absence of systemic toxicity in your vital signs (normal temperature, stable parameters) further supports a localized skin infection rather than disseminated sepsis.
